incidents.name: MEV bot 0x0ad8 unprotected arbitrary call
incidents.notes: The bot exposed a public entry point that executed caller-supplied calldata with no access control, letting the attacker make it pull 91,638 USDC out of a companion contract that had approved it.

sources.ref: onchain review: bot 0x0ad8229d4bc84135786ae752b9a9d53392a8afd4 created 2020-05-07T04:25:30Z by 0xd5b5b26521665cb37623dca0e49c553b41dbf076, unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment. Loss read from the tx receipt: 91,638.11 USDC moved from 0x211b6a11... to the attacker EOA.
